purpose: Provide a cash-constrained chronological account for frozen daily signal opportunities and explicitly registered exits. This is necessary support for the user's small-loss/large-win discussion, not evidence that such a strategy works or that the original net30 objective has been achieved.

isolation.preserve: All existing research implementations, protocols, results, portfolio modules and user workspace data remain unchanged. No global monkeypatch, actual trading, commit, push, packaging or deployment.

scope.supported: One frozen signal stream, one independently funded account, explicit research fee policy, existing close-based percentage exit controls and chronological opening execution.
scope.notYetImplementedByContract: Structural exits, volatility-based R sizing, dynamic policy switching, parameter training, rotation/shadow accounts, market-data trial runners or profitability certification.
scope.exitMeaning: The inherited stopLossPct/trailingStopPct/takeProfitPct controls are price-based close triggers, not guaranteed realized net return. maxHoldingDays counts independent calendar sessions including the entry session as one, but the inherited check runs only on a present bar with positive volume; missing or suspended sessions do not pause the calendar clock and can defer the trigger. Each future market registration must state these limits and may define a separate net-profit exit if needed. No numerical exit threshold is chosen by this engineering document.

signals.validation: Require a single declared strategy, unique signal IDs and unique (date,symbol) and (date,rank), known symbol/calendar date within the configured interval, integer originalRank within 1..5. Copy and hash the complete schedule and reject unsupported/ambiguous input.
signals.informationClock: Rows are opportunities known at the completed signalDate close. Read only that date's rows. Preserve original ranks and gaps; never rescore, reuse yesterday's signal, expand beyond the frozen Top5, or manufacture historical eligibility.
signals.futureMarketSource: Trial17 pre-active signals and selection.slots are potential inputs after a separate registration. Old events/filled/attempted-only subsets are not complete opportunity streams. No market stream is selected or replayed by this contract.

entryPolicy.budget: Each selected new opportunity receives entryWeight times signal-close marked equity, capped by the explicit configured entry stock-weight ceiling. entryWeight is common across candidates and supplied explicitly. The budget is frozen at the signal close; it is not increased from next-day prices or forecast sale proceeds.
entryPolicy.quantity: Freeze plannedQuantity at the signal close using that valid close increased by configured buy slippage and signal-date effective buy fees, respecting board lots. The next opening may reduce quantity for actual price, fees, cash or capacity, never increase it above the planned quantity.
entryPolicy.slots: At close, positions with an already pending forced exit can provisionally free a planned slot. Actual buys still require a genuinely free slot and available cash after opening sells. Keep only the highest original-rank eligible opportunities up to these planned slots; failed attempts do not admit another opportunity or a later retry.
entryPolicy.excluded: Do not add to an existing position, reenter a pending exit or reenter a symbol sold earlier that session. Original Top5 gaps stay gaps; there is no outside-pool backfill.
entryPolicy.attempt: Only the immediate next independent calendar session is eligible for the single opening attempt. Missing bars, untradable opens, insufficient cash, occupied slots or partial-fill remainder terminate that buy opportunity. At dataset cutoff with no next session retain explicit unattempted/censored status.
entryPolicy.priority: Use originalRank then symbol for all new buys. Do not let the inherited budget/score ordering silently replace the frozen rank. Report exactly the order used.

exitsAndAccount.ordering: Retain inherited dated corporate actions first, then pending forced sells in inherited deterministic symbol order, then new buys in frozen rank order. Only actual net sale proceeds enter available cash.
exitsAndAccount.persistentExit: A close trigger first becomes executable on a later calendar session. Its pending state survives missing prices, suspension, price limits and partial sales until the holding is fully closed. No rebound cancels a triggered exit.
exitsAndAccount.sellLock: Reuse inherited lot dates, unlock dates, sellability, price gates and opening-capacity evidence. Do not infer intraday execution from OHLC extrema.
exitsAndAccount.holdings: Keep old quantities unchanged until an explicit exit; no rank rebalance, averaging or top-up. entryWeight constrains initial allocation, not automatic trimming of later appreciation.
exitsAndAccount.valuation: Reuse the continuous cash/share/rights ledger, dated marks and stale/unresolved flags. Do not manufacture a final sale or drop open positions. Slippage is already in fill prices and is not deducted a second time.
exitsAndAccount.missingness: Unknown history, rights or opening capacity remains unverified. A passing engineering test does not certify these market-data inputs.

feePolicy.legacy: Delegate arithmetic exactly to the frozen PortfolioEngine._fees with its legal normalized config, including explicit zero stamp-duty overrides. This guarantees fee arithmetic compatibility only; the new fixed-signal order policy intentionally differs from the old selector and carry behavior.
feePolicy.dated: Use the frozen research_fee_profile function with explicit SH/SZ ordinary-A-share/exchange-auction scope, commission and transfer inclusion assumptions. Supported decision/execution dates remain 2022-2023; unsupported dates or conflicting overrides fail closed.
feePolicy.context: Every quote receives an explicit immutable context naming symbol, order-origin signal date, decision date, effective fee date, optional simulated execution date and purpose. The order-origin date is the original entry opportunity date for a buy and the first persistent exit-trigger date for a sell, matching fill.signalDate; the latter is not mislabeled as the original position-entry signal. executionSizing records the actual attempt date as decision/effective date with execution date null; a fillQuote includes that attempt's simulated execution date but is not a payment until committed. No shared current-symbol/current-order state or global hooks.
feePolicy.paid: Only a newly appended actual simulated fill books a paid-ledger record linked to that fill and its matching quote. Any number of partial fills is supported; probes and unfilled orders are never paid fees. Minimum commission remains per simulated fill, without a broker-specific aggregation claim.
feePolicy.evidence: Record the fee assumption profile and breakdown, quote-vs-payment distinction, actual execution date and frozen dependency identities. Do not label them actual broker charges.

implementation.reuse: Reuse the validated PortfolioEngine indexes and daily account progression through an isolated prepared/_shared instance with a frozen-signal scorer. Require explicit start/end and disable rotation; no actual strategy scorer may compute or select replacement signals.
implementation.overrides: Own target selection, fixed-close sizing and one-attempt entry execution. A controlled copy of _execute_order may replace only explicit fee seams while preserving its cash/lot/fill arithmetic. Keep the inherited daily rights, valuation, risk-exit and reporting mechanisms wherever their declared semantics fit.
implementation.checkpoint: Use a new envelope binding adapter version, normalized config, complete signal schedule, fee settings, source pins, entry policy, parent engine state and fee/research side state. Pass only parent engineState to the strict old restore path.
implementation.rollback: A failed day must restore both inherited account state and every quote, paid fee, ID/counter and opportunity disposition added by the adapter. No external untracked cursor or ledger may survive rollback.
implementation.identity: Reject config/policy/schedule/source drift, incompatible checkpoints and foreign owner context. Do not claim legacy whole-strategy parity when entry and continuation policies intentionally change.

syntheticAcceptance: Known-close decision and immediate-next-session execution; future close/high/low perturbations cannot alter the frozen plan.
Complete opportunity conservation, original rank/gap preservation, slot/cash exclusions, no same-day reentry and no buy carry after failed or partial attempts.
Persistent failed/partial sells, T+1 lot lock, actual sell-before-buy funding and maximum-position enforcement.
Signal-date sizing versus actual buy/sell fees across both historical fee boundaries, explicit zero overrides, per-fill minimum fee and no quote-as-payment contamination.
Cash, positions, cost basis, realized P&L, open marks and total fees reconcile against independently hand-computed small fixtures.
Chunked/checkpoint continuation equals a single run; injected failure after partial mutations rolls back all account and fee evidence.
Cutoff open positions and unattempted/failed exits remain visible, including stale or unresolved valuation; no automatic liquidation.
Controlled-copy comparison verifies no unregistered non-fee edits to inherited order arithmetic; original files stay byte-identical.
nextBoundary: Only after the synthetic adapter and independent oracle pass, register the actual signal source, account parameters, a bounded set of exits, costs, comparison metrics and data-quality limits, then freeze and run a new complete market trial.
